verdict.rationale: llamafile runs a local HTTP server with an API, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. The evidence never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths returning 404. The server's existence alone does not count as a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
